item.text: {"action":"write","arguments_json":"{\"path\":\"work.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Evaluate whether declared source dependencies have changed.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\nimport json\\n\\n_MISSING = {\\\"kind\\\": \\\"missing\\\"}\\n\\n\\ndef _canonical_json(value):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Return a stable representation using JSON rather than Python equality.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    return json.dumps(\\n        value,\\n        sort_keys=True,\\n        separators=(\\\",\\\", \\\":\\\"),\\n        ensure_ascii=False,\\n        allow_nan=False,\\n    )\\n\\n\\ndef evaluate(request, policy):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compare saved and current states for declared, non-ignored paths.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    ignored = set(policy.get(\\\"ignored\\\", ()))\\n    paths = sorted(set(request.get(\\\"declared\\\", ())) - ignored)\\n    saved = request.get(\\\"saved\\\", {})\\n    current = request.get(\\\"current\\\", {})\\n\\n    changed = [\\n        path\\n        for path in paths\\n        if _canonical_json(saved.get(path, _MISSING))\\n        != _canonical_json(current.get(path, _MISSING))\\n    ]\\n    return {\\\"needs_review\\\": bool(changed), \\\"changed\\\": changed}\\n\"}"}
